Anant Singh Daughter Wedding:'bihar men bahubli pahchan rakhne vale chhote sarkar yani ki anant sinh in dinon apni beti ki shadi ke chalte charcha men hain. jiski taiyari bare dhumdham se ki ja rahi hai. ye shadi islie bhi charcha men rahne vali hai. kyonki anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men siyasatdanon se lekar jane mane kalakar tak pahunchne vale hain. lekin isse jyada charcha vidhayak ki taraph se die jane vale gipht ki ho rahi hai.
